text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Elections start for members of professional chambers,
- Morocco and France study nuclear energy cooperation.
- National Airports Office (ONDA) reports good performances in 1996.
- Five seamen charged with selling part of the cocaine which washed up on Moroccan beaches in June.
- Health workers say they are determined to continue their struggle for pay increases and other benefits.
